scenes.headline: How one EEG model reads any electrode layout
scenes.sub: ZUNA 1.1 treats every electrode as a point on the scalp, not a slot.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Lavender! ZUNA 1.1 rebuilds brain signals from any electrode layout, headband or cap, with one set of weights. Here's how.

scenes.text: An electrode is not a slot in a fixed list. It is a token, tagged with where and when it was measured: x, y, z and t.
scenes.mark: where and when it was measured
scenes.say: The idea: an electrode isn't a slot in a list. It's a token, tagged with where and when it was measured.

scenes.title: Encode the context, decode any coordinate

steps.say: Each eighth of a second of one electrode becomes a token, placed by its spot on the scalp and its time.

steps.note: nearby means nearby in space and time
steps.say: A sixteen-layer encoder reads the clean context, with rotary positions on all four axes, and compresses it.

steps.note: the latent sets each layer's norm scale
steps.say: A sixteen-layer decoder starts from noise, and the latent conditions every one of its layers.
Out comes the signal at any coordinate: a dead channel, a noisy one, or one never recorded.

scenes.title: Why the decoder is cheap
scenes.say: It's trained with rectified flow: a straight line from noise to signal.

parts.note: a straight path at constant velocity
parts.say: The path is straight, so a few steps get most of the way. That's why it runs on a CPU.

scenes.title: Four ways to break a recording

steps.label: Whole-channel: dead electrodes
steps.say: Training breaks the input four ways. Whole channels die, so it learns to rebuild electrodes from neighbours.

steps.label: Full-time: every channel at once
steps.say: Every channel drops at once, which teaches filling gaps in time.

steps.label: Channel-time: a cluster, for a window
steps.say: A cluster goes bad for a while: the realistic case.

steps.label: Random-uniform: scattered artifacts
steps.say: And scattered blips, like muscle artifacts.

scenes.label: Spline interpolation at 90% channel dropout on Berlin BCI: NMSE about 2.7
scenes.note: ZUNA1.1 and ZUNA1 hold near 1.0 to 1.5, read off plots
scenes.say: Against predicting silence, which scores one: with ninety percent of channels gone, splines reach about two point seven. ZUNA stays near one to one and a half.

scenes.text: Key the model on where an electrode is, not which channel it is, and any montage is just another set of coordinates.
scenes.say: Key the model on where an electrode is, and any montage is just coordinates.

recap: Every electrode is a token at x, y, z, t
A flow decoder fills any coordinate you ask for
A rebuilt channel is a prior, not a measurement
scenes.say: To recap: electrodes as coordinates, a decoder that fills any of them, and a guess, not a measurement.
